Name: (PFM) Flower Pack for Artisanal Soda Makers
Author: maerumaer2u
Description:
[color=#e06666][size=5][i][b][u][color=#ea9999]As of SDV version 1.6 this is a deprecated version of this Mod!!
[/color][/u][/b][/i][/size][/color]If you are playing version 1.6 of the base game, head on over to Shads' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33086]updated version[/url], JSON Assets and PFM are no longer required frameworks!



(The text below is preserved from pre-1.6 versions of the game:)
A Chinese Simplified version of the pre-1.6 version of this mod by Kiwipart can be found at: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14044]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14044[/url]

Note that the latest version of this mod merges all three previous packs (Vanilla/PPJA, Specialty Flowers, and Blue Rose) into one.  Remember to DELETE all previous floral soda packs before updating!

Are you enjoying Hadi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url] mod but wish you had even more options?  Want more things to do with all your modded flowers?  [i]Want to add two full pages to your shipping tab??[/i]  Then this is the mod for you!

This mod adds functionality to turn edible* flowers into syrup, which can then be used to create floral sodas and cream sodas.  Each soda or cream soda has its own buffs and gift tastes as well!

[b]To Install:
[/b][list=1]
[*]Make sure you have the most recent versions of JSON Assets [i]and [/i]its dependencies, Producer Framework Mod, and Artisanal Soda Makers installed
[*]Make sure you have the desired crop mods listed below installed, otherwise PFM will skip the rules for all but the base game flowers (this will not impact your save file, and these mods can be added to your game at any time to enable their products in this mod)
[*]Unzip this mod into your Mods folder.  The main mod folder will contain two subfolders - one for JA, one for PFM
[/list]
This mod adds the following products to the Soda Maker mod machines:

[list]
[*][i][color=#b6d7a8]Syrup Maker[/color]:[/i] One flower + One Sugar = One floral syrup
[*][i][color=#ffd966]Artisanal Soda Maker[/color]:[/i] One floral syrup + One sparkling water = One floral soda
[*][i][color=#d9d2e9]Cream Soda Maker[/color]: [/i]One floral syrup + One sparkling water + One vanilla extract = One floral cream soda
[*][i][color=#00ffff]Carbonator[/color]: [/i]Three coal + One flower = One flower flavored sparkling water
[/list]
Edible flowers from the base game are included, along with products made with edible flowers from the following mods:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4472]Ancient Crops[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3438]Bonster's Crops
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2075]Farmer to Florist[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5020]Fish's Flowers - Compatibility Version[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3568]Lucky Clover[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028]Mizu's Flowers[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4513]Spoopy Valley[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3581]Six Plantable Crops for Winter[/url]

[b]Update March 24, 2021: [/b]Complete reorganization that combines all three packs (Vanilla/PPJA, Specialty Flowers, and Blue Rose). Updates all sprites for greater visual legibility. Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48693548]jina2ya [/url]for PFM update! 
Please note that if you do not have all included packs, the harmless yellow warnings that previously appeared in the SMAPI console have been disabled through PFM's new configuration option.  If you wish to receive these warnings, changing the config.json in the PFM folder from "Trace" to "Warn" will re-enable them in the SMAPI console.
[b]
Update July 29, 2020: [/b]Mod has been entirely rebalanced and generic products for flowers not part of the specialty pack have been added, both thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/Users/88065673]DraconicArcher[/url]!
[b]
Update February 27, 2020:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/56954962/]Wingyl [/url]has created a [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/quality-floral-sodas.5942/]Quality Artisan Products patch[/url] for both main download and the specialty pack- check it out if you want to add even more value to your products! [color=#ea9999]*NOTE*[/color] This version is based on previous versions of this mod and may not reflect the latest version.

[b]Update March 8, 2020: [/b]The main and specialty packs now have a Korean translation thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48693548]jina2ya[/url]!

*If there is a large outcry for sodas and syrups made from poisonous flowers, this may change, but in the interest of realism, only flowers you can actually eat in real life without needing your stomach pumped are included in this release.

[b][i]Coming [s]soon[/s][/i] eventually: [/b]Floral colas! (pending update to BAGI)

[b]Credits:
[/b]
Icons for the soda and cream soda bottles are modified from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5215]Zosa's Containers[/url]﻿ - thanks to Zosa for this fantastic resource!

Thank you to Hadi, KAYA, and the SDV MCN server, the PPJA team, Bonster, Amburr, FishWaffle64, and popobug for the wonderful mods!
